name: Guns and Dragons
description:
About This Game

About Guns & Dragons

“Guns & Dragons is an outrageous solo or co-op roguelite FPS set in a magitech fantasy world where up to 3 players grab their guns or bows and delve into caverns, dungeons, and even quaint villages to blast through hordes of enemy monsters with evolving weapon builds! Between runs, players expand their bases and develop gear infused with arcane technology that becomes ever-more powerful. Plan strategies that evolve with every run by combining runes, artifacts, and skills that make no two runs the same!

Whether you are chasing the perfect solo run, testing ridiculous weapon combos, or coordinating chaos with friends, your goals are simple: survive challenging combat, build impossible weapons, and see just how far over-engineered, fantastical firepower can take you.”

Game Elements

Dragons? Monsters? Who cares? BLAST ‘EM!

“Guns & Dragons is a fast-paced, exciting game for 1-3 players with intense combat that lets you pick your style and shoot the way you want to.  Defeat enemies to recover runes and artifacts, then use them to evolve your character and power up for your next run. The choices and combinations you make shape an entirely different experience each time!

  • Fight, grow stronger, and fight again. Defeat enemies in dungeons to collect runes and artifacts, and craft your character build.

  • Every decision you make reshapes the next battle. Steel yourself—a formidable boss awaits.

  • Slay enemies for a wealth of treasures: runes, artifacts, altar rewards, and more. Use them to level up, choose skills, and carve your path through enemies and trials. The combination you pick shapes an entirely different experience each time.

  • Combine runes, artifacts, and skills that evolve with every run to build ever-changing strategies and power up your character!

  • Use hard-earned materials to level up your base, unlock new facilities, and construct your magical companion. Fine-tune your firearms' functions and settings to arm yourself for the expeditions ahead, and take down monsters, even dragons.

This is your boomstick!

Revolvers, shotguns, longbows, sniper rifles, and that's just the beginning. Grab from a wide arsenal of over 45 bows and firearms and hone your own combat style. Every weapon has its own feel, and no two enemies go down the same way!

  • Revolvers, shotguns, and sniper rifles, oh my! And that is just the beginning!

  • Afraid of gunpowder? We have you covered with a selection of bows and crossbows for players who prefer twang to bang.

  • Grow your arsenal as you want. All weapons can be pushed far beyond their original design through unhinged upgrades.

  • Upgrade your weapons until you have the most OP armory in all the land!

Who says it can’t feel like home?

Even the toughest fighters need to rest between raids, and you get to do it in your custom-built offshore platform! Use materials won in combat to expand your base, which grants you new, better tech and gear to forge. What you craft between runs determines your abilities in your next run, so choose wisely!

  • Get stronger between raids in your custom-built hideout, an offshore base of operations!

  • Materials won in combat are used to expand your base. The bigger the base, the more tech and gear you can forge!

What you build between runs defines who you are and what you can do in your next run. Spare no expense!

Team Overview

  • Guns & Dragons is the brainchild of ABUTTON CEO Kim Dae-hwon and Game Director Park Jun-woo, who lead an incredible team that includes Design Lead Lee Chang-hoon, Programming Lead Choi Yu-tae, and Art Lead Yu Yong-seon

  • Our team has worked on some amazing games, including Counter-Strike Online, Wars of Prasia, AxE: Alliance vs Empire, Super Fantasy War, Blade & Soul 2, and Argent Twilight, among others.

  • We look forward to bringing you Guns & Dragons when the guns are fully loaded, and the dragons are hungry (basically, when we’re ready).
short_desc: Guns & Dragons is an outrageous co-op roguelite where up to 3 players grab their increasingly over-engineered weapons to fight enemy hordes and gather resources. After each run, build your base and power up your weapons for your next attempt. No two runs are ever the same!
